briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as US-China compute tensions escalate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny and infrastructure bottlenecks. Global AI funding surges past $14B this quarter while safety concerns mount over autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with advanced multimodal reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 while xAI and DeepSeek push inference optimizations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates; Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions; TSMC reports AI chip yield improvements amid export controls.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve coherent long-horizon planning before regulatory frameworks can contain misalignment risks?
